notes.title: Player hosted sessions
notes.content:
Now you can host your own sessions, at the moment you can choose 2 game modes but perhaps I'll add all kinds of configuration settings.

This is nice in case I add some kind of PvE mode in the future. A horde mode might be interesting if I find the time for it. Having player-hosted session is the first step towards that.

notes.title: Update Notes 29/09/2022
notes.content:
[list]
[*] prepared some work so players can host their own sessions (for when servers go offline)
[*] Added minimum 4 bots ( instead of 1 previously )
[*] Gave bots random names
[*] Bots will now sometimes jump to try and avoid shots or up to slopes
[*] Bots will try and use dash after jump for a combo movement
[*] Bots will pick slightly better positioning when attacking ( could make them even smarter but I think they should stay semi-dumb )
[*] Misc fixes.
[/list]
